test_least_squares_basic: test the minimize.least_squares function to solve a Rosenbrock residual minimization problem
test_least_squares_jacobian: test the minimize.least_squares function with a user-provided jacobian and derivative checking
test_least_squares_bounds: test the minimize.least_squares function with lower and upper bounds constraints on variables
test_least_squares_custom_norm: test the minimize.least_squares function with a custom minimize.Norm subclass for smooth-L2 loss
test_least_squares_iter_callback: test the minimize.least_squares function with an iteration callback that receives the optimization trace
